test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1) i.e. 'beautiful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**beautiful**' aptly describes the aesthetic appreciation of the stunted trees by the observers.
 
• Using '**beautiful**' conveys the idea that despite their stunted growth, the trees were admired for their artistic appearance.
 
• The term 'artistically beautiful' fits seamlessly into the narrative, emphasizing the aesthetic value that contributed to the spread of Bonsai.

**Therefore, the correct answer is 'beautiful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Other options are not fitted in the blank because:
 
• **"Cheerful" **and** "harmful"** do not directly relate to the physical appearance of the trees.
 
• **"Fruitful"** is more literal regarding production and does not primarily describe appearance.

Complete Passage is: Many years ago, when the art of stunting plants was quite unheard of except__ in remote areas of India, Buddhist monks in isolated monasteries in Tibet stunted trees like the oak, orange tree, peepal tree, etc, watching with __excitement____ __the tree still flowering and __bearing__ fruit regardless of this ‘deformity’. Since the trees looked so artistically __beautiful__, the art was learned by some Chinese monks who taught ‘Bonsai’ making, an art that became most sought 5. ______ in China.
